class.name: JRPGTilesetData
class.brief_description: A tileset: the tiles maps are painted with.
class.description: Database entry linking a Godot [TileSet] to JRPG maps. Map cells store an index into [member palette], and [member flags] holds each palette entry's movement and terrain flags, baked from the TileSet's custom data so that game logic and servers never need the TileSet itself.

method.name: get_no_entry
method.description: Returns the sides (bit 0 north, 1 east, 2 south, 3 west) through which a tile with flag word [param flags] cannot be entered.

method.name: get_no_exit
method.description: Returns the sides through which a tile with flag word [param flags] cannot be left.

method.name: get_pass_mode
method.description: Returns the pass mode of flag word [param flags].

method.name: get_terrain_tag
method.description: Returns the terrain tag (0 to 15) of flag word [param flags].

method.name: get_tile_flags
method.description: Returns the flag word of palette index [param palette_index], or [code]0[/code] for the empty cell and unknown indices.

method.name: pack_flags
method.description: Returns a flag word built from a pass mode, entry and exit side masks, a combination of the [code]FLAG_*[/code] constants and a terrain tag.

members.member: How autotiles treat the area outside the map.
Baked flag word per palette index; index 0 is the empty cell.
Hash of the TileSet custom data [member flags] was baked from, used to detect a stale bake.

Tiles maps can use, as dictionaries with [code]kind[/code], [code]source_id[/code], [code]atlas_coords[/code] and [code]alternative[/code]. A map cell's palette index is the entry's position plus one.

constants.constant: Outside the map counts as the same autotile kind, so terrain runs cleanly to the edge.
Outside the map counts as a different kind, so an outline is drawn at the edge.
The tile can be walked on.
The tile does not affect movement; the tile below decides.

Characters on the tile face up, as if climbing.
